method.dtype: E4M3 block FP8 compute, BF16 dW; BF16 control also BF16 dW
method.main: CUPTI GPU main kernel duration, max across ranks per sample, then median. No NCU injection.
method.wall: Separate runs without profiler: CPU wall through final CUDA synchronization, max rank per sample then median. Includes source quantization, communication, setup, FWD/BWD and API overhead. Excludes weight preparation and input/route generation.
method.caveat: Do not add phase spans or medians. Profiling wall times are not the unprofiled wall results. Pilot runs use 5 warmups/20 samples and must not be compared numerically against 10/30 production routes.

changes: FWD uint2 packed FP8 stores via four-lane halfword transpose; packed BF16 S temporaries; capture row metadata once.
FWD integer magnitude reductions fold invalid detection into amax while preserving BF16 rounding and block scales.
BWD warp integer row-amax reductions and PRMT byte packing for SwiGLU columns and X/dR row-to-column conversion.
FWD wave blocks 32/32/16 for qwen35b/qwen122b/flash, versus previous 64/32/16. BWD schedule unchanged.
retained_semantics: Same FP8 X/AB checkpoints, source FP8 communication, one-time globally reused X column conversion in BWD, BF16 dW and prequantized W/W-transpose. No extra allocations or kernels.
rejected: Universal half-size FWD wave regressed Flash 5-8%; only retain smaller wave for small experts.
BWD wave=32 and math register budget=232 regressed.
Bit-exact power-of-two FP8 decoder regressed BWD ~17%; reverted.
Standalone in-place X column conversion: EP2 small win, EP8 no win after including conversion cost; reverted.
Releasing operand stages before X conversion or before dR casting produced no stable extra Qwen35B win; reverted.
